Name: Brayflox Barns (CP and AT)
Author: madishartte
Description:
After 84 years, the Brayflox Barns are finally done! I didn't intend for this to take as long as it did, but my life went crazy for a bit there. I am finally returning to modding Stardew. Thank you everyone for your patience!!

Content Patcher version has Vanilla and Vibrant Pastoral recolor options in the Config menu.
